dialogues.title: Greeting a Friend
dialogues.description: Two friends catch up after not seeing each other for a while.

lines.text: 你好！好久不见！
lines.translation: Nǐ hǎo! Hǎojiǔ bújiàn! — Hello! Long time no see!

lines.text: 是啊！你最近怎么样？
lines.translation: Shì a! Nǐ zuìjìn zěnmeyàng? — Yeah! How have you been lately?

lines.text: 我很好，谢谢。你呢？
lines.translation: Wǒ hěn hǎo, xièxie. Nǐ ne? — I'm good, thanks. And you?

lines.text: 我也不错，工作有点忙。
lines.translation: Wǒ yě búcuò, gōngzuò yǒudiǎn máng. — I'm doing well too, just a bit busy with work.

lines.text: 有空一起吃饭吧！
lines.translation: Yǒu kòng yìqǐ chīfàn ba! — Let's grab a meal together sometime!

lines.text: 好啊，这个周末怎么样？
lines.translation: Hǎo a, zhège zhōumò zěnmeyàng? — Sure, how about this weekend?

dialogues.title: Ordering Food
dialogues.description: A customer orders a meal at a restaurant.

lines.text: 欢迎光临，请问几位？
lines.translation: Huānyíng guānglín, qǐngwèn jǐ wèi? — Welcome, how many people?

lines.text: 两位，谢谢。
lines.translation: Liǎng wèi, xièxie. — Two people, thanks.

lines.text: 好的，这是菜单，请看一下。
lines.translation: Hǎo de, zhè shì càidān, qǐng kàn yíxià. — Okay, here's the menu, please take a look.

lines.text: 我要一份宫保鸡丁和一碗米饭。
lines.translation: Wǒ yào yí fèn gōngbǎo jīdīng hé yì wǎn mǐfàn. — I'd like a Kung Pao chicken and a bowl of rice.

lines.text: 好的，还需要别的吗？
lines.translation: Hǎo de, hái xūyào bié de ma? — Okay, anything else?

lines.text: 不用了，谢谢。
lines.translation: Búyòngle, xièxie. — No, that's all, thanks.

dialogues.title: Talking About Weekend Plans
dialogues.description: Two friends plan a hiking trip, discussing conditions.

lines.text: 这个周末你有什么计划吗？
lines.translation: Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme jìhuà ma? — Do you have any plans this weekend?

lines.text: 我打算去爬山，如果天气好的话。
lines.translation: Wǒ dǎsuàn qù páshān, rúguǒ tiānqì hǎo dehuà. — I plan to go hiking, if the weather is good.

lines.text: 听起来不错，我可以一起去吗？
lines.translation: Tīng qǐlái búcuò, wǒ kěyǐ yìqǐ qù ma? — Sounds good, can I join?

lines.text: 当然可以！不过山路比较陡，你要做好准备。
lines.translation: Dāngrán kěyǐ! Búguò shānlù bǐjiào dǒu, nǐ yào zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi. — Of course! But the trail is quite steep, so be prepared.

lines.text: 没问题，我平时也经常锻炼。
lines.translation: Méi wèntí, wǒ píngshí yě jīngcháng duànliàn. — No problem, I exercise regularly too.

lines.text: 太好了，那我们早上八点出发吧。
lines.translation: Tài hǎo le, nà wǒmen zǎoshang bā diǎn chūfā ba. — Great, let's set off at 8am then.

dialogues.title: 求职面试
dialogues.description: A candidate discusses her career, challenges, and goals in a formal job interview.

lines.text: 谢谢您今天抽空过来。能简单介绍一下您的工作经历吗？
lines.translation: Xièxiè nín jīntiān chōu kòng guòlái. Néng jiǎndān jièshào yīxià nín de gōngzuò jīnglì ma? — Thank you for taking the time to come in today. Could you briefly introduce your work experience?

lines.text: 当然可以。我学的是市场营销，毕业后一直在一家科技公司负责产品推广。
lines.translation: Dāngrán kěyǐ. Wǒ xué de shì shìchǎng yíngxiāo, bìyè hòu yīzhí zài yī jiā kējì gōngsī fùzé chǎnpǐn tuīguǎng. — Of course. I studied marketing, and after graduating I've been in charge of product promotion at a tech company.

lines.text: 您觉得工作中遇到的最大挑战是什么？
lines.translation: Nín juéde gōngzuò zhōng yù dào de zuìdà tiǎozhàn shì shénme? — What do you think has been the biggest challenge you've encountered at work?

lines.text: 应该是去年的一次产品发布，因为预算突然被削减，我不得不重新协调整个团队的计划。
lines.translation: Yīnggāi shì qùnián de yī cì chǎnpǐn fābù, yīnwèi yùsuàn tūrán bèi xuējiǎn, wǒ bùdébù chóngxīn xiétiáo zhěnggè tuánduì de jìhuà. — It was probably a product launch last year — because the budget was suddenly cut, I had to re-coordinate the whole team's plan.

lines.text: 您是怎么在压力下让团队保持一致的？
lines.translation: Nín shì zěnme zài yālì xià ràng tuánduì bǎochí yīzhì de? — How did you keep the team aligned under that pressure?

lines.text: 我每天早上都会开一个简短的会议，这样问题可以及时发现，而不是拖到最后。
lines.translation: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu huì kāi yīgè jiǎnduǎn de huìyì, zhèyàng wèntí kěyǐ jíshí fāxiàn, ér bùshì tuō dào zuìhòu. — I held a short meeting every morning so that problems could be discovered in time, instead of being delayed until the end.

lines.text: 听起来是个不错的方法。您对未来五年有什么打算？
lines.translation: Tīng qǐlái shì gè bùcuò de fāngfǎ. Nín duì wèilái wǔ nián yǒu shénme dǎsuàn? — That sounds like a good approach. What are your plans for the next five years?

lines.text: 理想的话，我希望能带一个小团队，同时还能继续参与具体的项目工作，而不只是做管理。
lines.translation: Lǐxiǎng dehuà, wǒ xīwàng néng dài yīgè xiǎo tuánduì, tóngshí hái néng jìxù cānyù jùtǐ de xiàngmù gōngzuò, ér bùzhǐ shì zuò guǎnlǐ. — Ideally, I'd like to lead a small team while still being involved in hands-on project work, not just management.

lines.text: 您还有什么问题想问我们吗？
lines.translation: Nín hái yǒu shénme wèntí xiǎng wèn wǒmen ma? — Do you have any questions you'd like to ask us?

lines.text: 有,团队通常是怎么处理项目优先级上的分歧的？
lines.translation: Yǒu, tuánduì tōngcháng shì zěnme chǔlǐ xiàngmù yōuxiānjí shàng de fēnqí de? — Yes, how does the team usually handle disagreements about project priorities?

dialogues.title: 关于科技与社会的辩论
dialogues.description: Two friends debate the effects of social media, using persuasive language and discourse markers.

lines.text: 说实话，我觉得社交媒体对青少年之间的交流弊大于利。
lines.translation: Shuō shíhuà, wǒ juéde shèjiāo méitǐ duì qīngshàonián zhījiān de jiāoliú bì dàyú lì. — Honestly, I think social media does more harm than good for communication among teenagers.

lines.text: 我理解你的想法，但把责任都推给平台，是不是有点不公平？毕竟关键在于人们怎么使用它。
lines.translation: Wǒ lǐjiě nǐ de xiǎngfǎ, dàn bǎ zérèn dōu tuī gěi píngtái, shì bùshì yǒudiǎn bù gōngpíng? Bìjìng guānjiàn zàiyú rénmen zěnme shǐyòng tā. — I understand your point, but isn't it a bit unfair to put all the blame on the platforms? After all, it depends on how people use them.

lines.text: 也许吧，但算法本来就是故意设计成让人不停刷下去的，不管这对他们好不好。
lines.translation: Yěxǔ ba, dàn suànfǎ běnlái jiùshì gùyì shèjì chéng ràng rén bùtíng shuā xiàqù de, bùguǎn zhè duì tāmen hǎo bù hǎo. — Maybe, but the algorithms are deliberately designed to keep people scrolling endlessly, regardless of whether it's good for them.

lines.text: 这倒是真的。不过我觉得同样是这些工具，也让人们更容易和远方的朋友保持联系。
lines.translation: Zhè dào shì zhēn de. Bùguò wǒ juéde tóngyàng shì zhèxiē gōngjù, yě ràng rénmen gèng róngyì hé yuǎnfāng de péngyǒu bǎochí liánxì. — That's true. But I think the same tools also make it easier for people to stay in touch with friends far away.

lines.text: 话是没错，可是靠点赞和评论'保持联系'，跟真正的交流完全不是一回事。
lines.translation: Huà shì méi cuò, kěshì kào diǎnzàn hé pínglùn 'bǎochí liánxì', gēn zhēnzhèng de jiāoliú wánquán bùshì yī huí shì. — That's not wrong, but 'staying in touch' through likes and comments is completely different from real communication.

lines.text: 有道理。也许问题不在技术本身，而在于我们几乎没人教怎么合理地使用它。
lines.translation: Yǒu dàolǐ. Yěxǔ wèntí bù zài jìshù běnshēn, ér zàiyú wǒmen jīhū méi rén jiào zěnme hélǐ de shǐyòng tā. — Good point. Maybe the problem isn't the technology itself, but that almost no one teaches us how to use it wisely.

lines.text: 这一点我同意。要是学校能花一点时间教这个，情况可能会不一样。
lines.translation: Zhè yīdiǎn wǒ tóngyì. Yàoshi xuéxiào néng huā yīdiǎn shíjiān jiào zhège, qíngkuàng kěnéng huì bù yīyàng. — I agree with that. If schools spent a little time teaching this, things might be different.

lines.text: 没错——重点不是禁止这些工具，而是帮助大家养成更好的使用习惯。
lines.translation: Méi cuò — zhòngdiǎn bùshì jìnzhǐ zhèxiē gōngjù, ér shì bāngzhù dàjiā yǎngchéng gèng hǎo de shǐyòng xíguàn. — Exactly — the point isn't to ban these tools, but to help everyone build better habits around using them.
